content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Cedar Rapids

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate degree, or high school diploma affects your experience threshold. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you assess whether you meet PMI's criteria before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Cedar Rapids cohorts deliver the PMI-required contact hours through interactive online sessions, combining lecture, discussion, and real-world case studies. You'll learn the PMBOK® Guide framework while balancing your current work schedule in the Cedar Rapids region.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your formal education, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, documenting your project-management experience and education. Pay the associated PMI exam fee at the time of application. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the submission process and answer questions about required documentation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Leverage Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and review sessions—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your computer-based PMP exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts and build your confidence as you approach exam day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll enter PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved activities—continuing education, project work, volunteering, or community involvement. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to help Cedar Rapids professionals stay current and renew on schedule.
